text: Hello, I'm Jalil, one of the nurses on this ward.
I can see you're really sad and disappointed today.
This must be a lot for you.
What is on your mind right now?
What would make today a little better for you?
So missing her party feels like letting her down. Did I get that right?
The infection in your leg still needs a few more days of antibiotics, so it heals safely.
The doctor will be here at four o'clock, you can ask her about going home then.
note: doctor sentence: not a false promise

text: The doctor comes by this evening.
I'm here for you, I'm not going anywhere.
What if we set up a video call with your granddaughter during the party?
We could send her a photo of you with a birthday message.
Shall I help you sit up a little and get you something to drink?
How about a short walk together in the corridor?
Let's get you out of bed and walk to the window.
Don't worry, I'll ask the doctor to discharge you early so you can go to the party.
I'll make sure you can go home for the party.
I promise everything will be fine.
Don't be sad, there will be other birthdays.
If you don't feel like it, I'll just leave you alone.
Your CRP is still high, so the IV stays until the cellulitis resolves.
Can you hear me?
Stop whining, nobody cares about your stupid party.
Uh, okay.
